content.short: ByBarter enables users to convert fiat to crypto and back directly from their wallets.
content.description: ByBarter enables funding and withdrawals from self-custody wallets in a decentralized manner, reducing dependence on centralized exchanges. It highlights more than 400 distinct funding and withdrawal options, expanding how users can move funds into and out of crypto without relying on traditional banking relationships. The solution is designed to be inexpensive and aims to improve access to crypto for people without bank accounts, while helping prevent losses from centralized exchange crashes.
